findings.summary: Base constructor installs callback 0x10a0f48 in dialog+0x18, and 0x10a06c0 binds that holder to AgreeButton. The thunk dispatches dialog virtual +0x50, resolving to 0xee7780. The callback evaluates stability cost: nonpositive cost reaches 0xedfa40 directly; positive cost creates the confirmation dialog whose +0x50 is 0xee6a10, then its acceptance tailcalls 0xedfa40.
unknowns: Input-device event delivery and actual click timing have not been observed at runtime.
The cost helper and confirmation UI are engine-context operations, not arbitrary-thread read-only APIs.

findings.summary: Send callback 0xedfa40 writes current game date into cached action+0x28, obtains sender context from dialog+0x1b8 virtual +0x80, calls cached action virtual +0x40 (declarewar vtable resolves it to 0x4e9930) with a stack command holder, and directly calls 0x14ca210 with that holder. Sender 0x14ca210 clears the holder before its gates, stamps command fields and passes the command to context+0x58 virtual +0x30; true only records this local handoff branch. This GUI path does not use 0xbfe50.
unknowns: The downstream queue's complete ownership and failure/unwind behavior are not closed.
False does not restore the consumed caller holder; do not infer safe retry or caller ownership from the return bool.
Handoff does not prove execution, war creation, AI responses or save persistence.

findings.summary: Row constructor 0xedfc80 binds call_checkbox to callback 0xee32d0 and stores dialog at row+0x50, full country handle at row+0x60, participant-record byte at +0x74 and side byte at +0x78. Enemy rows receive side=0, ally rows side=1. If +0x74 is clear, ally-side toggles add/remove the country in action attacker+0x50; enemy-side toggles add/remove it in action full_ally+0x80. Matching compares the country-slot component while inserts preserve the full handle. The ally insertion path additionally calls 0xee03f0 and sets dialog+0x300 for rebuilding.
unknowns: Autojoin and subject/coalition exceptions have additional refresh and eligibility helpers; their transitive rules remain incomplete.
These vectors encode explicit selections, not a complete final war-participant list.
Do not reuse the row callback as a public API without live handle, type, side and eligibility checks.

findings.summary: promise_land_checkbox is bound to callback 0xee32a0, which toggles row+0x79 and calls 0xee3530. This UI byte is inverse to action promised_land membership: constructor sets +0x79 when the country is absent from action+0x68. Setting it false appends the full handle to promised_land+0x68; setting it true removes the handle from promised_land and also removes it from attacker+0x50. Removing attacker through call_checkbox does not itself remove promised_land in the decoded callback.
unknowns: Final UI refresh may impose additional membership constraints; no universal subset rule is asserted.
The promise setter has no complete eligibility check of its own; enabled UI state and engine-thread context must not be bypassed.
No favors, trust, promised-land settlement or participant effect was observed at runtime.

findings.summary: A goal row's banner callback 0xeda00c dispatches virtual +0x20, resolved by row vtable 0x1d3baf8 to 0xee3a50. That thunk passes row+0x58 selected goal to dialog 0xee7290. Selection deletes the old owned goal if +0x78 permits, clones the selected goal through 0xd9aaf0 and stores it in cached action+0x48. It reads selected goal's CB through +0x108 and conditionally clears attacker and promised_land end pointers when helper 0x1f7470 returns false, then rebuilds the participant lists.
unknowns: The semantic name and every switch case of CB helper 0x1f7470 are unresolved; only its conditional reset effect is established.
Selection owns a goal clone; row, dialog and command goal copies are separate lifetimes.
Current CB-instance validity and all goal-specific parameters still require preflight beyond selecting this row.

findings.summary: Dialog population 0xee6ac0 calls 0xd9eb40 with actor/target handles and an owning output collection. The enumerator visits bilateral CB entries through 0x28d560 and a second source from 0xd9ee50, resolves CB indices through a lazily initialized registry, and invokes 0xd9d220 to create specific goals. An observed builder path selects a goal definition from CB+0x170, dispatches its enum through 0xd9b080, then calls virtual setters +0x60/+0x100 with that definition and CB. The dialog moves generated goals into goal-row ownership and groups rows by CB-definition index.
unknowns: Builder 0xd9d220 has an unexpanded indirect switch at 0xd9d41f; complete goal-specific generation is not proven.
The second CB source, registry lifetime and all availability conditions remain unresolved.
This generator allocates, deletes and may initialize global registry state; it is not a read-only worker-thread query.

findings.summary: Dialog refresh 0xee4650 enables AgreeButton only when dialog+0x308 has no pending confirmation and cached action virtual +0x88 returns true with NULL tooltip and false mode. The final GUI send callback 0xedfa40 does not directly repeat local/full checks; it wraps and hands off the cached action. The downstream sender separately invokes command virtual gates, whose transitive action behavior remains outside this bounded closure.
unknowns: GUI enabled state is not a fresh authoritative API preflight for arbitrary actor/target pairs.
Local, common, goal and command checks must retain their separate meanings; transitive mutation and TLS remain unclosed.
No gameplay execution or effects are verified by the observed static path.
